description: Golden retrieval set: a realistic store, queries in EN/JA/zh with the note that must be in the top 3, and unrelated prompts that must recall nothing. Context repo defaults to `workspace`.

notes.text: The company proxy blocks GitHub GraphQL (gh pr create, gh pr view, gh pr checks) and the PR merge API with 403 "Noncompliant action". REST reads, REST POST /pulls, and git push work. Merge by fast-forwarding main and pushing.
GITHUB_TOKEN in the environment belongs to the work account; the gh CLI is logged in to the personal account. Use GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user <personal>) for personal repositories.
Design first: write the design doc and get it approved before writing code; then run a review and a security audit before merging.
Prefers replies in English; keeps Japanese UI terms as they are.
Docker Desktop must be running before docker compose; start it with open -a Docker and wait for the daemon.
live-notifier keeps the YouTube API quota counter in Redis; the daily limit resets at midnight Pacific time.
Run the live-notifier tests with pnpm test:unit; the e2e suite needs a local Redis on port 6380.
Homebrew lives under /opt/homebrew on this Mac; its python3 is 3.13, so use uv for other Python versions.
Use pnpm, never npm, in every repository.
Start Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9222 so browser-use can attach to the real profile.
Commit messages follow Conventional Commits, in English, without attribution lines.
The VPN drops connections to internal hosts after 8 hours; reconnect when curl to *.corp times out.
Translations into Traditional Chinese use Taiwan terms (軟體, not 软件).
Convert a screen recording to a GIF with ffmpeg -i in.mov -vf fps=10,scale=800:-1 out.gif.
Task cws-auto-publish: release runs publish the extension to the Chrome Web Store through the CWS API with a service account; see .github/workflows/release.yml.
Task live-notifier-setup: built the notifier that posts Discord alerts when a channel goes live; deployed on Cloudflare Workers with wrangler.
pnpm check runs typecheck, lint, format check, and tests with 100% coverage; tasks/ is excluded from coverage.
The default shell is zsh; rtk rewrites common commands to save tokens.
